quote: QuoteDone applies your approved rates to supported jobs. Missing pricing or scope goes to owner review. Operator does not include customer quoting.
booking: Google Calendar connection and approved availability are required for direct booking. A Calendly link is a separate scheduling path; without a connection, capture the preferred time for follow-up.
website: QuoteDone includes a text quote widget for your own website. It is separate from the phone agent and uses your approved pricing.
setup: Configure services, hours, business knowledge and pricing. Confirm the phone arrangement for your US or Canadian number before activation. Carrier control and a universal one-button forwarding switch are not established.
cost: Operator: $119/month, 300 minutes. QuoteDone: $279/month, 1,200 minutes; website quote widget included. $0.35/minute overage; no setup fee. Confirm billing currency, taxes and phone-related charges before buying.

quote: Published material covers personalized call handling and intake. Ask for a demonstration of a measured project quote using your approved rates; the reviewed pages do not establish that workflow.
booking: Ruby lists Calendly, Google Calendar and other scheduling tools. Confirm your calendar, booking permissions and rescheduling workflow.
website: Ruby offers managed website chat. Chat has separate allowances and can be bundled with receptionist service.
setup: Flexible call forwarding and phone hosting are advertised. Confirm your provider, routing hours and what happens when you answer calls yourself.
cost: Receptionist examples: $250/50 minutes or $395/100 minutes monthly. Website chat is a separate plan or bundle. These are minutes, not calls; confirm overage and regional terms.

quote: Custom intake and workflows are described. That does not by itself establish a measured project calculation; demonstrate the approved-rate job and exception path you need.
booking: AI scheduling lists Calendly and more. Human receptionist booking is a separate paid capability; confirm the exact product and calendar connection.
website: Confirm the website-inquiry product and its price separately. AI Receptionist call allowances do not establish that website chat is included.
setup: Human plans offer a dedicated number or free number porting. Confirm the AI or human plan’s routing and escalation arrangement for your existing number.
cost: AI Pro: $150/month for 75 calls. Human Starter: $300/month for 30 calls, $11.50/additional call. Booking and other human-plan capabilities can add charges. Calls are not minutes.

quote: Larry advertises price-book access and service-fee communication. Check the complete measured job and selected extras rather than assuming a service fee is the whole project price.
booking: Larry books onto Podium’s dispatch board using technician availability. Confirm how your present calendar or FSM participates in the offer.
website: The home-services bundle lists website chat, text AI and an all-in-one inbox. Confirm which channels are included in your proposal.
setup: The reviewed bundle includes an FSM. Account migration, training and the phone arrangement are part of evaluating that broader purchase.
cost: The reviewed home-services plan is sales-quoted; no numerical subscription price was published. Request the full bundle, onboarding, usage and add-on costs.

quote: The reviewed offer emphasizes AI CSRs and scheduling. Ask to see your trade’s measured job priced from approved rates, including any unpriced extra.
booking: The directory lists ServiceTitan, Jobber, FieldRoutes and Service Fusion. Confirm the actions and availability checks supported by your specific integration.
website: Website quote-widget inclusion was not established in the reviewed phone offer. Confirm website lead handling and any separately priced product.
setup: Sameday says it can provide a forwarding number or integrate with systems such as ServiceTitan Phones Pro. Confirm the route for your existing phone system.
cost: Launch: $449/month with 500 minutes; Scale: $789 with 1,000. Confirm currency, overage, contract and integration charges; the published amounts are not an all-in quote.

quote: The reviewed inbound product describes booking and escalation. Confirm how approved pricing, quantities and exceptions are handled for your trade.
booking: Avoca advertises booking and ServiceTitan customer, job and notes writeback. Confirm your CRM’s integration and permissions.
website: Avoca advertises web chat and web-lead handling. Confirm the channels, booking actions and fees in your proposal.
setup: Choose integrations and escalation destinations. Avoca also describes a trained human-backup program; its availability and price need confirmation.
cost: No numerical subscription price was found on the reviewed product pages. Request base, usage, web chat, coaching, integration and human-backup costs.

quote: The reviewed Receptionist help page does not establish measured project quoting. Ask for your approved-rate example; Jobber’s own quote tools are a separate workflow.
booking: Receptionist uses your Online Booking settings to schedule services and team members. Enable the relevant booking and appointment permissions.
website: Jobber separately documents request and booking forms for websites. That is distinct from a conversational, owner-priced quote widget.
setup: An eligible Jobber account and dedicated Jobber number are required. Existing-number calls can be forwarded; check your carrier and pause behavior.
cost: Eligible-plan add-on: $29/month, 30 conversations, then $0.79 each. Plus includes unlimited usage. Include the base Jobber subscription; calls and 24-hour text sessions have different counting rules.

quote: CSR AI references configured prices for services enabled in Online Booking. Ask for a measured, multi-item project demonstration; do not assume service-price lookup is that calculation.
booking: CSR AI can book, reschedule and cancel with the permissions you enable. Service selection and availability need setup in the Housecall Pro account.
website: CSR AI Chat can book jobs and manage appointments, with escalation to your contact. Confirm eligibility and pricing for chat.
setup: Housecall Pro supplies a forwarding number. Its FAQ says temporarily stopping AI call handling requires deactivating forwarding; confirm the process for your carrier.
cost: CSR AI is an optional add-on to Housecall Pro. The reviewed pages do not give a numerical add-on rate. Include the base account and any paid HCP Assist workflow.

quote: ServiceTitan documents configured dispatch fees, including after-hours fees. Confirm measured project pricing separately from quoting a job-type dispatch fee.
booking: Voice Agent books jobs into ServiceTitan’s workflow. Confirm enabled job types, dispatch rules, availability and account eligibility.
website: The reviewed Voice Agent offer covers phone handling. A website quote widget is not established as included; confirm the separate website flow.
setup: The documented emergency feature applies to basic Phones, Phones Pro and Contact Center Pro. Confirm your telecom product, account access and number routing.
cost: The official search-indexed offer lists $2.75 per call. Direct page text is incomplete. Confirm that rate, base ServiceTitan/phone costs, currency and eligibility before purchase.
